title: Part 7 雙篇閱讀
summary: 兩篇文章一起看：答案要「對照兩篇」才找得到。

steps.title: 重點觀念
body: 多益 Part 7 後半段會出現兩篇或三篇文章一組，例如「廣告＋email」、「課表＋簡訊」。
有些題目只看一篇就能答，但一定會有一題要兩篇一起看。例如 email 說要「有陽台的房間」，廣告寫「有陽台的是豪華房」，答案就是豪華房。

steps.title: 解題技巧

head: 題目
中文
去哪裡找
rows: What kind of room does he want?
算日期（8 號減 5 號）

steps.tip: 看到題目有 probably、most likely，通常要兩篇一起推論。

items.en: I would like to book a room with a balcony.
items.zh: 我想訂一間有陽台的房間。

items.en: Stay three nights or more and get ten percent off.
Can you save me a seat?

steps.title: 模擬練習
steps.intro: 每題都會顯示文章，看完題目再回文章找答案。⏱ 限時練習：每題建議 60 秒內作答，題號旁邊會倒數；超時不會被打斷。

questions.prompt: Clark 先生想要哪一種房間？
questions.explanation: email 說要 a room with a balcony，廣告寫有陽台的是 Deluxe room。要兩篇對照。
questions.sentence: What kind of room does Mr. Clark want?
questions.text:
[Advertisement]
Hillside Hotel — Summer Special
• Standard room: $90 per night
• Deluxe room (with balcony): $130 per night
• Free breakfast for all guests
• Stay 3 nights or more and get 10% off!
Book at www.hillsidehotel.com

[Email]
To: reservations@hillsidehotel.com
From: Jason Clark
Subject: Booking

Hello,
I would like to book a room with a balcony for my wife and me from August 5 to August 8. Could you also tell me if there is parking at the hotel?

Thank you,
Jason Clark

questions.prompt: Amy 和 Ben 上的是哪一堂課？
